description:
Annotate the start and end of the surgical case in Vital Recorder based on the respiratory (EtCO2) signal.

Vital Recorder is open with VitalDB Case #3 loaded. Your task is to identifying the clinical 'Start' and 'End' of the case and add event markers:

1. Find the FIRST valid EtCO2 waveform (beginning of regular ventilation). Right-click the timeline at this moment and add a Memo/Event named 'Case Start'.
2. Find the LAST valid EtCO2 waveform (end of ventilation). Right-click the timeline at this moment and add a Memo/Event named 'Case End'.
3. Export the event list to a CSV file named 'case_milestones.csv' in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\'.

The export must contain the timestamps and text for these two events.
